[h2]【Mother Teresa】[/h2]
She is a nun from Macedonia. She founded the Congregation of the Missionaries of Divine Love, which works for those who are not needed by anyone, and has received numerous honorary awards, including the Nobel Peace Prize.

notes.title: 【Weekly!? S.O.G Report #2】Ono no Komachi
notes.content:
Includes portraits of 200 of the historical greats featured in “Summoner of Greats.

Portrait No.46
[h2]【Ono no Komachi】[/h2]
A poet of the Heian period. Her poems, which are included in the Hyakunin Isshu (One Hundred Poems), are often passionate love poems. There are also many anecdotes about her as an extremely beautiful woman.

notes.title: We will exhibit at “Tokyo Game Show 2024”!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768108/db6c6cf557b33beb84cc8bee633864f01e8366b2.png[/img]

Tokyo Game Show 2024, one of the largest game events in Japan, will be held at Makuhari Messe from Thursday, September 26 to Sunday, September 29, 2024. A playable demo of this game will be exhibited at the iGi booth.
We look forward to meeting you!

Tokyo Game Show 2024 official website：[url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/jp/]https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/jp/[/url]

notes.title: Game controller support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768108/0e8d4e1ad259e97e4e220eb57743121730b97776.png[/img]

In response to your requests, we have added support for game controllers.
This support is for a number of controllers and provides seamless operability.
We will continue to do our utmost to provide a better gaming experience for everyone.
